And here it is - Part 2 of our look at cryptocurrencies featuring an interview with @dogecoin co-founder @ummjackson. 

Find it on @ApplePodcasts or at our website: https://t.co/oiQ8kIcrXg #dogecoin

"I think the history of banking and the financial sector has shown us that the average person doesn't necessarily want to be their own bank." - @Dogecoin creator @ummjackson in the latest @moonshotpod.

Listen on @ApplePodcasts: https://t.co/QlsZFbh9Ih #dogecoin #bitcoin #crypto

"Hey, why don't we, just for kicks, make this a real thing, just so we can both learn how the code of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies works?" @ummjackson talks about how he created his own cryptocurrency, @dogecoin 🐕
